verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 docs say its management software provides node-wide GPU administration and can be used for cluster- and data-center-level management. The system also supports scriptable interfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP) and health-check commands across DGX nodes. That implies some ability to act on many GPUs or nodes at once, but no explicit bulk-operation workflow is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk or batch actions across many nodes or GPUs, a programmatic API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), any AI-agent-oriented automation surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
